agent_context.content: Design a 4–5 month, knee-friendly strength + cardio program (3–4 sessions/week, 45–60 min) using 24 Hour Fitness plus a home fallback; include progressive overload, exercise substitutions, and a simple warm-up/mobility plan

I need to create a comprehensive 4-5 month strength and cardio program for someone with knee considerations. The goal is clear: design a program that works at 24 Hour Fitness with home alternatives, includes progressive overload, substitutions, warm-up/mobility, and runs 3-4 sessions per week for 45-60 minutes. I have enough information to proceed directly to planning without additional research, as this is a well-defined fitness programming task based on established principles.
